notes: Environment-provisioning task (medium, total 13): the agent authors an idempotent /app/provision.sh that must create two named venvs, install a gRPC toolchain and a Jupyter notebook server SYSTEM-WIDE at exact pinned versions, install the chain-query package + Flask + requests into a serve venv, and launch two persistent background services -- all WITHOUT disturbing the platform-pinned torch/transformers baseline (offline_load.py + an exact-version check fail if it is altered). Exact-version pinning throughout gives quantitative_correctness=2 and tool_breadth=2 (venvs, grpc tools, jupyter, flask, pip freeze lock); dependent_stages=2 because every subsystem must be consistent and the provisioner must be idempotent/re-runnable; the verifier re-runs provision.sh and pushes 4 hidden /height cases (valid, mixed-case+whitespace normalization, bad-length, non-hex) against the live service so hidden_case_generalization=2 and adversarial_inputs=2; debugging_ambiguity=2 because failures surface as missing ports, broken imports, or version drift. No multi-stage recurrence beyond one idempotent re-run, no statefulness-beyond-daemon, no unsafe-action pressure.
